import ctypes
import os

# Load the required libraries
libgslcblas_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so"
libgsl_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so"

ctypes.CDLL(libgslcblas_path, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL(libgsl_path)

# Define the gsl_sf_result structure
class GslSfResult(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("val", ctypes.c_double),
        ("err", ctypes.c_double)
    ]

# Define the function prototypes
gsl.gsl_sf_synchrotron_1.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_sf_synchrotron_1.restype = ctypes.c_double

gsl.gsl_sf_synchrotron_2.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_sf_synchrotron_2.restype = ctypes.c_double

def compute_synchrotron(x):
    """Compute synchrotron radiation functions gsl_sf_synchrotron_1 and gsl_sf_synchrotron_2."""
    if not isinstance(x, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("Input must be a floating-point number.")

    result_1 = gsl.gsl_sf_synchrotron_1(ctypes.c_double(x))
    result_2 = gsl.gsl_sf_synchrotron_2(ctypes.c_double(x))

    return result_1, result_2
